mei-hashiloach.title: Mei HaShiloach
mei-hashiloach.desc: Teachings of Rabbi Mordechai Yosef Leiner of Izbica on the Torah, the festivals, Tanach and the Talmud. The complete Bnei Brak 5781 edition (Volumes I–II and the Likkutim) as a Hebrew–English interlinear, with a headline for every teaching, sub-headlines, 5,173 source notes and parallels in the Beis Yaakov, Sod Yesharim, Tiferes Yosef, Rav Tzadok and R. Leibele Eiger.
